video_title: Draymond Green Reacts to Steph Curry Injury, Jaylen Brown vs. Jayson Tatum + Martin Lawrence

quotes.speaker: Draymond Green
quotes.summary_phrase: Draymond Green on Stephen Curry's oblique abdominal injury timeline
quotes.excerpt: An oblique abdominal injury is one of those things that it tells you when it's healed.
quotes.quote: The Rockets broke our eight-game winning streak. Stephen Curry left the game in the first quarter with right abdominal soreness, which ultimately turned out to be, after an MRI, an oblique abdominal tear. He will be re-evaluated in two weeks. Re-evaluated in two weeks, I would say there's probably no chance that he's back in two weeks. You're just re-evaluating in two weeks and seeing where you are. An oblique injury is one of those things that it tells you when it's healed. There's no set certain timeline. Some of them heal faster than others depending on the severity, depending on where it could be. Some of them heal faster than others, some of them take longer. So there's no certainty. But then you get to the point where you need your core strength, you need your rotational strength. You need all of those things. So as you progress, as the pain starts to subside, you start to push the boundaries more and more. But no one knows how long that will take. I think after a few days, you start to get a better picture of what it is that you're looking at.

quotes.speaker: Draymond Green
quotes.summary_phrase: Draymond Green on the Houston Rockets' physical playstyle
quotes.excerpt: I don't get off into the dirty thing. Every now and then you see some people that just do things that are downright dirty.
quotes.quote: I know a lot of people are saying the Houston Rockets are a dirty team. I don't get off into the dirty thing. Every now and then you see some people that just do things that are downright dirty and it happens, and when it does, I'll speak on it. Do they do some bullshit when we play them? Absolutely. I think the thing that irritates me the most is like they play super physical but then they start flopping sometimes. So I would say that irritates me more, but I'm not going to sit here and call them a dirty team. They're a physical team. And by the way, when we were watching film pregame, you can see on the film, they're physical as hell. And so get them credit. They did what they needed to do to win the game. I'm not going to sit here and call them a dirty team, definitely not going to do that. But in saying that, they are a very, very physical team.

quotes.speaker: Draymond Green
quotes.summary_phrase: Draymond Green on the need for team depth without Stephen Curry
quotes.excerpt: We're going to need guys to step up. I'm going to have to shoot more. No if, ands, or buts about it.
quotes.quote: As we move forward, at least without Stephen Curry for the next three weeks at least, and then you're probably re-evaluated from there, we're going to need guys to step up. I'm going to have to shoot more. No if, ands, or buts about it. Going to need the guys to step up. It's a lot to ask for a rookie. I think what we've seen is this rookie is cut out for it. Brandin Podziemski is going to have to step up. And by the way, both of those guys have been playing incredible. Both of those guys have been stepping up. But the one thing that we've spoken about with this team is our depth, and we're going to need guys stepping up. Moses Moody is going to have to step up. As I said before, it sucks that Brandin Podziemski is out. You look at it, Brandin Podziemski averaging almost 11 points in 14, 15 minutes per game. Just that speed burst, that ability to break a defense down and get into the teeth of the defense and finish or kick out and create shots for others, we're going to miss that. And like I said, especially with Stephen Curry out, it would have been ideal to have Brandin Podziemski healthy right now.

It's the first matchup of Jaylen Brown versus Jayson Tatum since the trade. Jayson Tatum finished with 21, six and four. Jaylen Brown finished with 13, five and two. That's what Paul George said. And to be honest, I think a lot of people thought like, yo, Boston's about to fall off, like Paul George ain't got it no more and Boston has picked right up where they left off at. quotes.speaker: Draymond Green
quotes.summary_phrase: Draymond Green on Jaylen Brown's reaction to being traded
quotes.excerpt: Jaylen Brown not making eye contact with Jayson Tatum, Jayson Tatum come hit you on your chest try to say what's up.
quotes.quote: Jaylen Brown not making eye contact with Jayson Tatum, Jayson Tatum come hit you on your chest try to say what's up, you don't make eye contact. I think that's part of the reason Jaylen Brown played bad. Because your aura ain't right, your juju ain't right. You got to the head down and stuff then it carried over into the game. And so I don't really love that, man. Number one, like, you know, he's upset that he got traded, you know, and feel like Jayson Tatum could have stopped it or regardless, man, like I've never really got off into that when guys do that when they get traded and take it out on the player. You speak to every player but not him. I don't really love that, man. But the bar is so high on the respect level for Jaylen Brown from everybody and he's earned that respect. Just to see it, to see him do that, I don't love. I don't love it at all and I just think, you know, when you do that, the thing that you're upset at is haunting you. Like it owns you until you like break out of it. And so, you know, my word to Jaylen Brown would be like, no, man, talk to that man. Say what's up. Move on because until then, that thing going to hold you. It's it's going it's going to hold you, no matter what. You may feel like, oh, I moved on and all that, until you are willing to face that, address that, that that thing is going to hold on to you.

quotes.speaker: Martin Lawrence
quotes.summary_phrase: Martin Lawrence on his approach to stand-up comedy
quotes.excerpt: It was freedom at its best. You know why? Because we had Richard Pryor that led the way.

text_blocks.speaker: Draymond Green
text_blocks.text: You came up in the stand-up world, eventually becoming the host of Def Comedy Jam. What was what was comedy like during that era for you?

text_blocks.speaker: Martin Lawrence
text_blocks.text: It was freedom at its best. You know why? Because we had Richard Pryor that led the way. That's Godfather comedy. You know, that said, hey, you could do it this way. You could do it this way. And then Eddie came along, you know, and and Rock Star took it to the Rock Star status. You know, let you know you could do it this way. You could do it this way. So for all us young comics, you know, we was that it gave us hope. It gave us like, oh man, if if they could do it, I could do it. I could do it. So, you know, when I first did my first stand-up uh uh uh uh concert film, I had on leather, green green leather with boots, army boots and you know, everything, I was hip-hop. I was I was the hip-hop, you know, comedian there. You know, so, you know, but I had on the leather, you know, I was I was following after Eddie with the leather, you know, so, you know, it's just uh, you know, it's a it's a good thing, man. But it comedy is a little different to today because everybody has a opinion and they they want to judge you on everything.

text_blocks.text: They want to judge what you say and what you do and everything. They don't want to relax on about freedom of speech and everything. You know, and it's and it's and it's a lot of bull and that's what comedy is today and people people scared to say this and scared to say that and don't want to do this and don't want to do that and everything. But they ain't giving their real selves to the audience. They they they're not giving the audience authentic, you know, material. You know.

quotes.quote: I knew in my heart I was funny because I make people laugh in the neighborhood. So I went back the next week. Each time I got on stage I got better and better and due to the grace of God, I never had a bomb show from that night.
